## About
Memory Lane is a full service auto body and collision repair shop on S Florissant Road, near the University of Missouri St. Louis. We're family owned and operated, and our technicians are certified union craftsmen.
If you've been in an accident, we'll work directly with your insurance company or give you an estimate. We take the time to find the best and most affordable way to fix your car, and we can often repair damaged parts instead of replacing them.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 26 Google reviews. Stop by any weekday and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Major collision repair: Repairs for cars that have been through a serious accident.
- Dent and body repair: Fixing dents, dings and body damage, repairing parts where we can.
- Hail damage repair: Straightening and refinishing panels damaged in a hail storm.
- Frame straightening: Frame alignment for vehicles in a major collision.
- Expert refinishing: Paint and refinishing with color mixed in our shop.
- Windshield and glass replacement
- Headlamp reconditioning
- Chip guard and undercoating
- Towing: We can arrange a tow through Raptor Towing if your car isn't driveable.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: No. Bring your car in during normal business hours and we'll look at it. We never charge for estimates.

Q: How soon will I get my estimate?
A: We take some photos while you're here and email you an estimate by the following day.

Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We'll work directly with your insurance company, or we can give you an estimate.

Q: What if my car isn't driveable?
A: Give us a call and we can arrange a tow.

Q: Can I drop my car off outside business hours?
A: Yes, before and after hours drop off is available. Please contact us before you drop off.
